newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso sails to seven-month high by close.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso sails to seven-month high by close.

text.p: Colombia's peso rose 3.9 on dollar sales by the corporate sector to close at a seven-month high of 1,032.50, interbank dealers said.

The level was the peso's highest close since February 16 and the rise came on the back of shrinking demand for U.S. currency and scattered sales of greenbacks by banks and financial institution, traders said.
"The few dollars that entered the market knocked down the (dollar) rate because there was very little real demand," one trader said in a telephone interview.
He and others said the trend toward a stronger peso was expected to continue this week as the local currency, which hit an intraday low of 1,037.30, tests key resistance at 1,030.00 to the dollar.
Dealers reported 206 trades for a below-average total of $79.6 million.
